rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3BA grade, but it overstates image-specific certainty and includes fine details (quadrant location, absence of vacuolization/necrosis, uniform TE/zona features) that may not be reliably verifiable from a single embryo image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly matching the favorable profile, though some quantitative claims are more assertive than the available data support.

Mostly aligned on SET and general embryo assessment, but includes less guideline-based suggestions such as ERA/immunologic workup and somewhat liberal discussion of assisted hatching/PGT-A in a good-prognosis first cycle.
Provides clear next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, though some recommendations are more expansive than necessary for this straightforward first-cycle good-prognosis case.
